Reproducible optimality basis
Item
Detail
State
For each processed date and spend $0…$900, retain the greatest attainable point total.
Transition
For a date, enumerate no award or one eligible county; add whole-session cost/points only when within budget.
Objective
At month end choose the feasible state with greatest points (tie broken by lower spend, then deterministic row order).
Feasibility
The recurrence enforces ≤$900, at most one county/date, whole sessions, eligible observed weekdays only.
Certificate
ResourceSummary gives the final optimum; ResourcePlan gives every candidate and selected set, allowing direct recomputation.
